title: Bounded LRU cache with TTL boundary, purge-before-evict, sliding expiry, loader and stats

hidden_checks.spec: Rule 1: default_ttl must be None or a number > 0; otherwise the constructor raises ValueError.
Rule 1: set raises ValueError for a ttl <= 0, and in that case the cache is left completely unchanged.
Rule 1: set/get_or_load raise ValueError for a ttl that is not None and is <= 0 ... nothing changed.
Rule 3: live while clock() < expires_at; at clock() == expires_at it is expired.
Rule 3 (treated as absent by every operation) + rule 9 (in/len/peek consider only live entries).
Rule 2: effective TTL is the ttl argument if not None, else default_ttl.
Rule 2: an effective TTL of None means the entry never expires.
Rule 5: set on a stored key replaces its value and restarts its expiry using the new effective TTL.
Rule 4: a get hit makes the key most recently used; rule 6 evicts the least recently used.
Rule 4: set of an existing key makes it most recently used.
Rule 5: updating a stored key never evicts or expires any other entry.
Rule 4: peek, in and len never change recency.
Rule 6: first removes every expired entry; only if still full evicts the LRU entry; rule 12 counts expirations vs evictions.
Rule 6: removes **every** expired entry before considering eviction.
Rule 6: No purging happens when the cache is not full.
Rule 6: evicts the single least recently used entry; rule 12 evictions count.
Rule 7: every hit resets expires_at to clock() + d, d = the entry's own effective TTL (not default_ttl).
Rule 7: peek and in never extend expiry.
Rule 7: every hit from get or get_or_load resets expires_at.
Rule 7: with sliding=False reads never change expiry.
Rule 9: peek changes nothing (no removal of expired entries, no statistics); rule 8/12: get removes it and counts an expiration.
Rule 9: len(cache) is the number of live entries at the current clock time.
Rule 10: True if a live entry was removed, False if absent or expired (expired entry still removed); rule 12 expirations.
Rule 11: on a miss calls loader(key) exactly once, stores and returns the result; later calls hit.
Rule 11: a stored value of None is a valid cached value.
Rule 11: stores the result with effective TTL from ttl/default_ttl (rule 2).
Rule 11: if loader raises, the exception propagates unchanged and nothing is stored for key.
Rule 11: a miss stores via rule 6 (capacity/LRU eviction); rule 4 recency.
Rule 12: stats() returns a new dict with exactly hits/misses/evictions/expirations; peek and in not counted.
